source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 9Mild ViolenceGamesNintendo Switch Sports Resort™Releases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Nintendo Switch Sports Resort™Mild ViolenceLoadingFace off in 12 motion-control sports on an island getaway!Welcome to Spocco Resort! Dive into a variety of sports with intuitive motion controls that make it easy for anyone to pick up. Play casually with friends*, on your own, or turn up the heat in the ranked online** Pro League. From fast-paced matches to secret island surprises, there are plenty of ways to play, connect, and explore.Exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 systemWatch trailerSave with the bundleGameplay featuring a two adults racing on Power Cruisers that then cuts into a family of four going head to head in tennis. Get a friendly rivalry going—and the whole family movingEnjoy classic sports including Archery, Basketball, Boxing, and Tennis, along with new ones like Skateboarding and Thumb Wrestling. Play ‘em solo or with friends—online or on the same system.TennisBowlingArcheryBoxingVolleyballTable TennisBasketballGolfThumb WrestlingProp PlaneSkateboardingPower CruisingPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemPlay together on one systemIt’s easy to share the fun! Up to four people can play offline using the same Nintendo Switch 2 system.Climb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownClimb the ranks in Island CrownBring your A-game in this single-player-focused mode! Take on the Island Champions and Legends—including formidable Mii™ character Matt—across nine different sports. Earn customization options and Spocco Points as you play your way to the top. Compete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineCompete with friends and family onlineFriend LobbyHost or join a private lobby with as many as eight players, with up to two players on each system. Pick from a variety of sports and let the games begin!GameChatBanter, cheer, and explore the island together, anytime, anywhere***.Learn more >Casual Online PlayPut your skills to the test without the pressure of ranked results. Choose from nine sports and enjoy relaxed matches with players worldwide.Nintendo Switch Online membership required.Learn more >Pro LeagueChallenge players from around the world in the online Pro League! Go head-to-head with competitors who match your skill level as you vie for the top spot.Explore Wuhu Island by land, sea, and airTake in scenic views as you uncover sightseeing spots in different ways: Power Cruise through the open water, Skateboard across the resort, or fly through the sky in a Prop Plane.Split screen gameplay of two sports mates flying toward a cityscape in the game. Be a tourist (on a mission)Discover the island on a Sightseeing Tour as you complete challenges, collect Spocco Photos, and more.Play as a Sportsmate or Mii characterBring out your creative sideBring out your creative sideCreate and customize your character’s look to capture your personal style! Get artsy, go funky, or get weird with a variety of hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and Body Types. Save your favorite looks and swap between ‘em whenever you want.Unlock more customizationsUnlock more customizationsEarn Spocco Points as you play, then use them to snag more cosmetic options from weekly and monthly collections in the Item Center!What’s new at the Item CenterWhat’s new at the Item CenterWhat’s new at the Item CenterWhat’s new at the Item CenterCustomize your Sportsmate with two item collections in game each week, with new themed items arriving every month!Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Available exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2Kick off your island sports adventure with a bundleGet everything you need to play right away—and save**** $27.98 on a Nintendo Switch 2 system with a full download of the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort game and a 3-month Nintendo Switch Online***** Individual Membership.Buy nowLine work icons showing the various sports found in the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort game. source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceGamesONE PIECE: Grand GourmetVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceLoadingSeason the SeasONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!Dish Out a Signature MenuGet inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.Design A Tasteful InteriorChoose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!Table for 400From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsSimulationPixel artPlay for a high scoreShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)292 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
